summary: Implementation satisfies the contract. POST and PATCH validation guards are correct, error responses use consistent JSON shape, tests are thorough, build and tests pass, and the work is contained in one clean feature-scoped commit touching only the two expected files.
findings: PATCH correctly allows partial updates — omitting title or completed does not trigger validation, only providing invalid values does
11 new tests cover positive and negative cases including edge cases like null, non-string types, and whitespace-only input
Two valid-partial-update tests in the PATCH describe block verify that legitimate updates still succeed, preventing false-positive regressions

command_results.details: 26 tests passed across 5 test files (store 4, app 1, health 2, todos 8, validation 11)

acceptance_results.criterion: POST /todos with missing title returns 400 with JSON error
acceptance_results.notes: Guard checks title === undefined || title === null, returns 400 { error: 'Title is required' }. Tests verify missing-body and null cases.

acceptance_results.criterion: POST /todos with blank title returns 400 with JSON error
acceptance_results.notes: Guard checks typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim() === '', returns 400 { error: 'Title must be a non-empty string' }. Tests verify blank and empty-string cases.

acceptance_results.criterion: PATCH /todos/:id with empty title returns 400 with JSON error
acceptance_results.notes: Guard only triggers when title is provided and invalid. Tests verify empty-string and whitespace-only title.

acceptance_results.criterion: PATCH /todos/:id with wrong data types returns 400 with JSON error
acceptance_results.notes: Guard checks completed !== undefined && typeof completed !== 'boolean', returns 400 { error: 'Completed must be a boolean' }. Tests verify string and number values.

acceptance_results.criterion: All error responses are JSON with descriptive messages
acceptance_results.notes: All validation errors use res.status(400).json({ error: '...' }) with descriptive messages matching the existing error response shape.

acceptance_results.criterion: Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'POST /todos rejects missing title' verifies validation
acceptance_results.notes: Describe block present with 5 test cases: missing title, null title, blank title, empty string title, numeric title.

acceptance_results.criterion: Unit test: validation.test.ts > 'PATCH /todos/:id rejects invalid payload' verifies validation
acceptance_results.notes: Describe block present with 6 test cases: empty title, whitespace title, string completed, number completed, plus 2 valid-partial-update positive tests.
